name: HIST 3210
title: Archaeology of the Age of Sail
description: (Also offered as ANTH 3532, MAST 3532.) Overview of archaeological and historical sources on the development of seafaring and navigation, exploration, waterborne trade and economic systems, colonialism and empire building, naval warfare and shipbuilding in Europe, Asia and Australia from the fifteenth to the beginning of the twentieth century.
requirement_description: Recommended preparation: ANTH 1500, ANTH 2501, or ANTH 2510.
